title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: During the board meeting investigation, Sumathi emotionally alleges before everyone that Anbu misbehaved with her. Kanmani questions her about the alleged misconduct.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
episodeTitle: Paraman Refuses to Admit His Love
description: Paraman dismisses Ilamathi's claims that he is deeply in love with her. Rishi's men spot Paraman leaving the hotel and seize the chance to kidnap Ilamathi from the hotel.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: When Divya panics over missing bride Swetha, Karna rushes to save her from her abductor, Vetri. During a cliffside fight, Vetri vows to expose Karna for killing Parvathy.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar plans to strike the pot near Poongodi's head during the blindfolded game. Poongodi outsmarts Azhagar by distracting him and avoiding his attempts to hit her.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan and Lakshmi warn Malar and Mathi for lying the dietitan. Malar defends herself, Mathi faces Suresh, and Revathi clashes with Thangaraj over dietitian Kalpana.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi plans Thangamayil's bangle ceremony. A stressed Saravanan hides it from Anjali, but Pandian and Senthil pressure him to attend for the baby's sake.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran comforts tearful Chandayatha as memories of her parents overwhelm her. Pandian grows anxious when Vannathi leaves his messages unanswered, deepening his doubts.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Nachiyar forces Vijaya to grind batter manually, but Meena helps. Meanwhile, Muthu's rival analyses his tactics and tempts his clients with deals.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Karuppu is accused by Sethupathi and Rajangam of leaking secret tender details. Though he tearfully denies betraying them, Rajangam firmly orders him to leave the family home.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun sees Aadhavan and Pooja fleeing along the road to avoid her stepmother. Kasthuri rejects Sethupathi's proposal, but he continues to pressure her into accepting it.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Teased about his love affair, Shanmugam is forced into chores by Murugan, Karthikeyan, and Kumaran. To break free, Shanmugam threatens to reveal Indhira's secret work.
